c75485677.notes: Painted entrance arch of Boʻzi mahalla (neighbourhood), Samarkand. Top beam: the name in double quotes printed as two closing-style marks ” ... ” (U+201D), and the oʻ mark is a grave-like stroke stored as U+0060 to match the glyph. The two side posts carry 'XUSH KELIBSIZ' (Uzbek, left) and 'ХУШ ОМАДЕД' (Tajik Cyrillic, right) written vertically, one letter per row; word spaces are inferred because the stacking leaves no clear gap. Two cars under the arch show plates incidentally.
